data.text: Update (2026-07-31, same session): the init flavor picker (tuh-01KYX9VTPE9EBNBMBBNXY5XRAQ, point 5 of the previous note) was archived same-day on Brandon's call, accepting two arguments against building it: (1) staleness — scaffolding files baked into the shipped binary encode fast-moving harness conventions (skill formats, AGENTS.md idioms) that a docs page can fix in minutes but a binary teaches wrong indefinitely, with tuhdoo's authority behind it; (2) menu-of-one — only one flavor (Brandon's) exists or is proven, and a picker with one real option plus filler is worse than a link to one excellent doc. Surviving scope for this task is the floor: init emits links to recipe docs after success; recipes are docs pages with copy-pasteable, vendorable per-host blocks. If distinct proven flavors ever accumulate and formats settle, a picker could be re-raised as a fresh capture — nothing here forecloses it.
